title: Fit-to-rail is unpinned at the app layer: no test asserts play_w after the D-toggle or resize, and no camera test runs with the rail on
detail: Deleting view_set_rail at main.odin:1075 and :635, or reverting off_x/zoom/pan/pullback to win_w (main.odin:1723,1856-1857,1884,1795), leaves the entire suite green. The DOCK-RIGHT state transition ships unverified.
recommended_fix: Extend noc_toggle_test pins: after effect_overlay assert app.view.play_w == win_w - NOC_RAIL_W (on) and == win_w (off); add one rail-on camera test (off_x centers on play_w/2, pan/zoom clamp to play_w); extract the resize re-apply into a testable helper.

title: HUD re-anchoring on play_w (settings modal, audio caption, mode label/nudge) has zero automated coverage
evidence: app/render/settings_panel.odin:55: `x := (f32(v.play_w) - w) / 2`; app/main.odin:1600: `draw_text(app, mode_label, app.view.play_w - rnd.hud(&app.view, 320), app.view.win_h - rnd.hud(&app.view, 24), rnd.hud(&app.view, 15), p.ink_soft_text)`; app/main.odin:2240: `x := (app.view.play_w - w) / 2` — grep shows no *_test.odin references settings_panel_rect, draw_audio_caption, or the mode-label anchor; the harness overlay path never draws them rail-on.
detail: Reverting all three anchors to win_w passes every test and golden (harness never draws these with D on). The modal/caption/label could silently sit under the rail.
recommended_fix: Unit-pin settings_panel_rect centering with play_w < win_w (x + width <= play_w); add a rail-on smoke asserting caption and mode-label right edges stay <= play_w.

title: Per-class column math for 18px numerals (del/drop/loss/SLA/rate right edges) is untested
evidence:
app/render/noc_overlay.odin:685-690: `name_x := i32(px + 6)
	del_r := name_x + 196 // name zone (6..196 = 190px) + the 7-digit del column
	drop_r := del_r + 84
	loss_r := drop_r + 84
	sla_x := loss_r + 16
	rate_r := px + NOC_PANEL_W - 6` — inline locals inside draw_noc_panel; no test file references them, and overlay-pixels only counts `diff` pixels (harness/overlay.odin:261).
detail: The spec's 'recompute the column math' behavior has no pin: overlapping columns or an overflow past the 504px rail would pass all gates, only caught by one-time KYLE review.
recommended_fix: Extract column right-edges into a testable proc (e.g. noc_class_columns(px)); unit-pin monotonic order del_r < drop_r < loss_r < sla_x < rate_r <= px + NOC_PANEL_W.

title: The 'rail never covers the top-band HUD' draw-order contract is exercised but never asserted
detail: Reverting the order (rail over cards) still yields diff >= 1000 inside the rail rect, so the local smoke passes either way. The user-ruling ordering contract has no automated assertion.
recommended_fix: Extend overlay-pixels: also assert zero pixel diff inside the health-card/forecast sub-rects between overlay-off and overlay-on frames (cards paint identically only when drawn last).

title: Row-density pins are indirect: the visible-row test duplicates the production formula, and noc_panel_rows / NOC_ROWS_* caps have no direct test
evidence:
app/render/noc_overlay_test.odin:248-251: `v := View{}
	v.win_w = 1280
	v.win_h = 720
	visible := i32((v.win_h - NOC_CONTENT_Y - NOC_CONTENT_BOTTOM) / NOC_ROW_H)` duplicates app/render/noc_overlay.odin:621 `visible := i32((v.win_h - NOC_CONTENT_Y - NOC_CONTENT_BOTTOM) / NOC_ROW_H)`; grep shows no test references noc_panel_rows or NOC_ROWS_*.
detail: A formula change in draw_noc_panel (e.g. different inset) escapes the duplicated test; the changed caps (8/6/6/6/10) are guarded only by structural constant-sharing, not pins.
recommended_fix: Extract the visible-rows expression into a proc shared by draw and test; pin noc_panel_rows total (and cap values) for a fixed stats/events fixture.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: P0 100% (zero-drift/stream-neutrality pinned by CI golden harness, drift-rejection, .t1 sidecars). P1 ~77% (8/11 FULL: ladder, panel rect, hit/wheel-policy, camera_fit, crisis clamp, visible rows; measure/draw agreement PARTIAL; fit-to-rail wiring + rail-on camera NONE). Overall ~60% (8 FULL, 2 PARTIAL, 5 NONE of 15 traced behaviors) — below the 80% floor.
recommended_fix: Pin the D-toggle/resize play_w transitions in noc_toggle_test, add one rail-on camera composition test, unit-pin the settings-modal/caption anchors and column right-edges, and assert top-band-over-rail ordering in overlay-pixels. That lifts overall above 80%.
